channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michael Finley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michael Finley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Michael Finley, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Mark Cuban on the Luka Doncic trade:

“I talked to Patrick (Dumont) about it, you could justtell that Nico just shit on Luka. because some of the stuff that Patrick was telling me was not true. “Yeah. And kudos to (Michael Finley) for really trying to stand up and block it.”

Mark Cuban on Michael Finley, Luka Doncic, Jun 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shannon Brown on Michael Finley, Tim Hardaway
item.description:

Shannon Brown on Michael Finley, Tim Hardaway, Dec 30, 2019. Source: Forest Park Review.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Michael Finley
item.description:
